items.reason: Abstract-level only; hold full verification pending article; check prior September/August entry.

items.sourceLevel: PubMed primary abstract available through official search index; publisher/full text inaccessible; registry page yielded no study content.
items.reason: Hold. Need full paper, outcome denominators/timepoint, margin/CI, safety details and online publication date.

items.title: Anastomotic reinforcement versus preventive stoma, retrospective PSM
items.sourceLevel: Primary PubMed abstract verified; full primary source not verified.
items.reason: Primary abstract only; full article requires institutional access. Retrospective PSM cannot establish equivalence; retain pending full methods and safety verification.

items.title: Tumor-informed ctDNA AccuScan cohort, n=28
items.sourceLevel: Primary PubMed abstract verified; full primary source not verified.
items.reason: Primary abstract only; publisher access returned403. Small observational assay cohort, not ctDNA-guided randomized treatment evidence; retain pending complete denominator and validation review.

items.title: BREAKWATER Cohort3 EC+FOLFIRI historical coverage gap
items.sourceLevel: Primary abstract and registry outcomes verified, complete later publication not verified.
items.reason: Separate73/74patient cohort; May31 publication not new November readout. Full publisher text403; keep apart from mFOLFOX6 cohort. Registry still does not post this cohort PFS/OS.

items.title: SCOT imCMS retrospective biomarker analysis
items.sourceLevel: Primary abstract verified; publisher returned HTTP 403; full effect estimates/interaction tests unavailable.
items.reason: 2816 informative cases; prognostic but abstract explicitly reports no differential benefit prediction by chemotherapy duration/regimen. Do not change canonical SCOT chemotherapy conclusions. Complete full-text verification required.

items.title: SITC 2026 abstract 553: mutant-p53 TCR-T phase II interim
items.sourceLevel: Official Nov7 conference recap verified; complete original abstract/poster unavailable.
items.reason: Newly discovered conference backfill, not a new Nov7 efficacy readout. Mixed-tumor phase II interim includes CRC; verify original CRC denominator, response criteria, cutoff, confidence intervals and complete safety before inclusion. No numeric conclusions promoted. 2026-11-09身份复核：不能将该NCIⅡ期报告直接归于Alaunos NCT05194735；原始摘要注册号仍待核实。 2026-11-10登记复核：NCT05194735为已因资金/业务原因终止的AlaunosⅠ期混合实体瘤队列，8例接受输注，其中4例CRC；Ⅱ期未启动，首次结果发布于2025-11-10。登记说明数据库未完成全面清理、长期随访提前结束，不能作为上述NCIⅡ期报告或CRC特异疗效证据。

dates.original_abstract_release: Regular supplement generally released 2026-11-03; individual abstract metadata unverified.

items.title: MIRACLE-3 (NCT06593548): trial-in-progress, clinical results pending
items.sourceLevel: Official registry JSON and official publisher-indexed ESMO GI 2025 trial-in-progress abstract; no clinical results posted.
items.reason: Protocol-only, planned 36 (33 evaluable), not observed enrollment or efficacy. Do not promote to outcome evidence. Annals calls AK112 ivonescimab, while registry currently names Ivosidenib/Lvosidenib; retain explicit unresolved discrepancy. Current registry status UNKNOWN, last update 2024-09-19; planned completion is not proof of study completion.

items.title: Long-Term Survival After CRS-HIPEC for colorectal Cancer Peritoneal Metastases
items.sourceLevel: Full publisher text/PDF checked; quantitative curation deferred for unresolved reporting discrepancies.
items.reason: CC-0-selected uncontrolled cohort does not establish incremental HIPEC benefit. Complication total/subgrades, one survival CI and narrative/table hazard estimates require clarification before consistent extraction. Preserve original values; do not silently repair.

items.title: Wait-and-Watch Strategy Following Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy for Rectal Cancer: prospective Indian cohort
items.sourceLevel: Primary abstract verified; publisher full text requires access; PMC release embargoed.
items.reason: New indexing is not new publication. Hold complete population, surveillance, regrowth and salvage/safety verification until primary full text is available.

items.title: ASAC aspirin after curative-intent treatment of CRC liver metastases
items.sourceLevel: Primary indexed abstract identified; full text retrieval returned403.
items.reason: Historical negative phase III evidence gap, not new Nov8 result. Need complete methods, analysis sets and safety verification before curation; retain reported95.44% CI level if later added.

items.title: SALLY raltitrexed plus irinotecan q2w versus q3w post-hoc analysis
items.sourceLevel: Primary PubMed abstract; complete publisher text not retrieved.
items.reason: Observational post-hoc dose-schedule comparison cannot establish equivalence. Verify efficacy and safety analysis sets (abstract q3w denominators618 and619) and full results before curation.

items.title: TORCH-E2 ESTRO 2026: primary-source drug discrepancy unresolved
items.sourceLevel: Original ESTRO abstract plus official current registry and public V1 history verified; administered-drug identity conflict remains unresolved.
items.reason: 原始ESTRO摘要标题/方法写帕博利珠单抗（pembrolizumab），TORCH-E2登记NCT06462053写特瑞普利单抗（toripalimab）；原始摘要未列NCT号。2026-11-09复核官方公开历史，只有V1（2024-06-12提交、06-17发布），明确toripalimab 240 mg每3周；没有可见后续版本解释差异，未核实到勘误。不能擅自替换药名或将两来源结局合并。摘要仅报告101例入组中的51例治疗完成者，非最终ITT；未命名PP集，未报告比较P值/CI或成熟器官保留随访。
items.resolutionNeeded: Original corrected abstract, public protocol amendment or subsequent primary report that verifies the administered PD-1 drug and connects the reported cohort to the registry.

items.title: TORCH-LE (NCT06455124): protocol only, clinical outcomes pending
items.sourceLevel: Original peer-reviewed full-text protocol and official registry verified; no trial outcome report or posted results.
items.reason: 仅研究方案：高危pT1或pT2早期低位MSS/pMMR直肠癌局切后，单臂Ⅱ期，计划60例。无实际入组或疗效/安全性结果，设计假设不能当作观察结局。登记仍列Recruiting但最后更新2024-06-13，预计完成日期已过不证明实际完成。方案与登记的入组边界、以及文内肠镜监测频率存在差异，留待澄清。

protocol.design: Prospective multicenter open-label single-arm phase II
protocol.regimen: Post-local-excision SCRT 25 Gy/5 fractions, then four cycles of CapeOx + toripalimab
protocol.primaryEndpoint: 3-year local recurrence-free survival from treatment start to first pelvic recurrence

items.title: MRI, ERUS and FAPI PET/MRI after SCRT plus chemoimmunotherapy in pMMR LARC
items.sourceLevel: Primary PubMed abstract verified; complete publisher text inaccessible.
items.reason: Single-center retrospective surgical cohort; modalities assessed in unequal, partly overlapping subsets. Need complete selection and paired-comparison methods, confidence intervals and safety/context before curation. Diagnostic performance is not treatment efficacy and cannot establish safe omission of surgery.

items.title: FIND randomized ctDNA-guided intensified surveillance after curative CRC surgery
items.sourceLevel: Primary abstract and publisher publication chronology checked; publisher full text/PDF returned HTTP 403.
items.reason: Historical coverage lead, not a new November readout. Need complete eligible/randomized/recurrence analysis denominators, follow-up, intervention pathway, confidence intervals, harms and limitations before inclusion. Earlier detection and receipt of curative-intent treatment do not establish an overall-survival benefit.

items.title: Emergency laparoscopic versus open colonic resection: retrospective propensity-matched study
items.sourceLevel: Full original publisher text checked; inconsistent open-surgery denominator prevents quantitative curation.
items.reason: Historical August publication newly indexed. Mixed benign/malignant emergency cohort; abstract open-surgery count (377) conflicts with body (368), while total is 484. Matching and conversion groups require careful analysis-set extraction; residual confounding remains. Do not infer a randomized treatment advantage or generalize mixed-cohort outcomes to CRC.

items.title: Muzastotug (ADG126) plus pembrolizumab randomized dose-optimization enrollment milestone
items.sourceLevel: Original sponsor announcement and SEC exhibit; enrollment milestone, not clinical results.
items.reason: Sponsor reports completion of a 60-patient randomized dose-optimization cohort in late-line MSS CRC without liver metastases. Initial results are expected in the first half of 2027. No new efficacy/safety dataset; retain as follow-up lead only, separate from any prior nonrandomized cohorts.

items.title: Fruquintinib plus FOLFIRI/FOLFOX second-line RAS-mutant mCRC phase II
items.sourceLevel: Full peer-reviewed manuscript retrieved through Europe PMC fullTextXML; current official registry checked.
items.reason: 42 treated,40 response-evaluable (one consent withdrawal and one early progression excluded). Table 2 combines a40-person header with survival estimates while methods define FAS/PPS without clearly mapping reported PFS to an analysis denominator. Registry last updated 2022-12-02 describes single-center planned 68 versus paper multicenter planned 43/actual 42; no updated public amendment verified. Keep unresolved rather than infer a PFS analysis set or reproduce cross-trial superiority claims. Supplement download returned HTML instead of DOCX.
items.resolutionNeeded: Clear survival analysis population and protocol/amendment chronology; full supplementary material if it resolves those discrepancies.

items.title: HAIP floxuridine after repeat local treatment for liver-only recurrent CRC
items.sourceLevel: Original indexed abstract verified; full publisher article returned HTTP403.
items.reason: Single-arm phase II, 45 patients; abstract reports failure of the prespecified 36-month hepatic disease-free survival hypothesis, with clinically relevant biliary toxicity. Preserve this negative lead. Full eligibility, analysis sets, endpoint/censoring methods and adverse-event detail remain unverified; do not present abstract results as a full-paper-reviewed record.

items.title: ABILITY-1 MDNA11 SITC 2026 GI-cancer subgroup
items.sourceLevel: Original scientific presentation and sponsor chronology checked; conference-stage evidence.
items.reason: Reported ORR pools 20 evaluable MSI-H or MSS/TMB-high GI patients across histologies and monotherapy/combination cohorts;8 responses include only 5 confirmed. The 40% figure is not CRC-specific. Require a CRC-specific denominator, confirmed-response accounting, timepoints and complete safety before curation. Nov 10 webinar is not first data release.

items.title: Pretreatment T2WI AI prediction of response and prognosis in LARC
items.sourceLevel: Primary indexed abstract screened; full methodological review not completed within this run.
items.reason: Historical August retrospective development/validation study newly indexed. Moderate external discrimination and inconsistent DFS associations are exploratory; not evidence that imaging can safely replace surgery or guide a treatment change. Retain as lower-priority methodological lead.

items.title: SPLT totally laparoscopic versus laparoscopy-assisted left hemicolectomy
items.sourceLevel: Primary indexed abstract screened; complete matched analysis and safety not reviewed.
items.reason: Historical August retrospective 178-patient cohort newly indexed.45 versus133 are pre-matching counts; do not infer matched denominators, causal superiority or long-term oncological equivalence from short-term findings.

items.title: Comprehensive genomic profiling by RAS/BRAF status in mCRC
items.sourceLevel: Primary indexed abstract screened; full eligible cohorts and denominators not verified.
items.reason: Single-center retrospective CGP testing study. Actionable/discordant genomic findings do not establish clinical benefit from testing or a treatment regimen. Full plasma/tissue denominators and treatment-history confounding need review before quantitative curation.

items.title: PRABITAS: simplified 14-day versus conventional 28-day FTD/TPI plus bevacizumab
items.sourceLevel: Original PubMed abstract verified; complete Lancet paper, supplement and registry not available through attempted public routes.
items.reason: Historical Oct 24 phase III noninferiority trial, not a Nov 11 new readout. 972 randomized but 970 analysed (14-day 484, 28-day 486); full eligibility, exact safety denominators, treatment-related deaths and per-protocol/sensitivity NI analysis remain to verify. Primary abstract establishes NI, not OS superiority. Hold complete curation rather than rely on secondary 970-randomized wording.

items.title: Initial 100 da Vinci single-port colorectal surgeries
items.sourceLevel: Publisher and PubMed original abstract verified; full methods and safety not accessible.
items.reason: Single-center retrospective 100-patient surgical case series, 72 colon/28 rectum, no randomized or concurrent comparator. Short-term feasibility cannot establish oncological equivalence or superiority to multiport robotics. Full eligibility, follow-up and complication details remain unverified.

items.title: Robotic TME 135-patient single-center oncological cohort
items.sourceLevel: Publisher original abstract and metadata available; full article requires subscription.
items.reason: Retrospective 135-patient single-arm cohort; no advantage of a CRM 5 mm threshold demonstrated. Full effect estimates, analysis denominators and safety unavailable; cannot infer robotic superiority or replace randomized surgery evidence.

items.title: Capecitabine survival letter and authors reply
items.sourceLevel: PubMed letter metadata verified; no abstracts; publisher returned 403.
items.reason: Full correspondence and the exact underlying cohort/consequence are unverified. Do not infer a correction, retraction or a change to reviewed capecitabine trial results from titles alone.

items.title: NEXERA-204 INCA33890 after resection and chemotherapy in ctDNA-positive MSS CRC
items.sourceLevel: Official registry and Nov 10 sponsor protocol announcement checked; no results posted.
items.reason: Single-arm phase II planned 40; ctDNA-positive stage II/III MSS CRC after curative resection and chemotherapy. Registry last updateSep 22 remains NOT_YET_RECRUITING with estimated dates. Collaboration or planned start does not establish enrollment, efficacy or safety; await actual results.

items.title: Sintilimab plus CAPOX induction versus consolidation around SCRT in pMMR/MSS LARC
items.sourceLevel: Original protocol full text reviewed; no clinical results.
items.reason: Planned 36 patients; both groups contain sintilimab+CAPOX and 30 Gy/6 fractions. No immunotherapy-free comparator, efficacy or safety outcomes. Retrospective registration June 2025 after first enrollment December 2024. Do not treat design hypotheses as results.

items.title: CREATE versus conventional double-stapling for ultralow rectal cancer
items.sourceLevel: Original PubMed abstract retrieved via EFetch; complete publisher article unavailable through attempted routes.
items.reason: Retrospective multicenter PSM: 448 eligible, 168 matched (60 CREATE/108 conventional). Functional analysis restricted to stoma reversal and completed LARS questionnaires; exact timepoint denominators and full safety need verification. Early LARS association does not establish oncological noninferiority; no significant 24-month LARS difference.

items.title: Laparoscopic versus open sphincter-preserving rectal surgery: Fudan retrospective PSM cohort
items.sourceLevel: Publisher article and reference PDF reviewed; unresolved internal denominators.
items.reason: Historical August 12 first publication, not a new November readout. 9405 selected and 7738 matched (open4993/laparoscopic2745); main text and tables contain conflicting complication/mortality and temporary-stoma counts, denominators and percentages. Do not silently repair or curate numbers until reconciled. Anatomical sphincter preservation is not preserved continence or absence of LARS. Single-center retrospective association with temporal confounding and unequal followup.

items.title: CTRI/2021/05/033642: TNT versus conventional CRT interim randomized trial
items.sourceLevel: Original PubMed abstract screened; full paper not reviewed this run.
items.reason: Historical February 2026 publication surfaced by metadata update. 172 randomized (87/85), interim analysis150 (75/75). No primary pCR difference; exact pCR denominator, full safety and interim analysis plan require full-text verification before inclusion. Do not promote secondary 1-year distant-metastasis finding to mature survival superiority.

items.title: Colesevelam for major LARS: pilot randomized placebo-controlled crossover trial
items.sourceLevel: Publisher full text retrieved from observed public CDN redirect; complete supplementary DOCX and CONSORT checklist read. Original ANZCTR registration not accessible.
items.reason: Overall LARS score remains negative(P=0.645),49 randomized/36 PP completers. Composite response was exploratory and unvalidated. Publisher abstract reports SF12-MCS+2.36 with95%CI0–10.25, whereas Table2 reports median3.46 with IQR0–10.25; do not relabel IQR as CI. Table1 sequence-sex counts conflict with percentages and total. TableS5 AE percentages imply36 completers but does not explicitly define safety denominator or grade distribution;13 randomized withdrawals include3 colesevelam and1 placebo constipation withdrawal. Original registration unavailable to verify prespecification and amendments. Retain pending rather than create a verified clinical record.

dates.publication_date_note: Publisher November13 differs from PubMed day metadata November3; preserve provenance.

items.title: Local excision versus ISR after nCRT: response-selected two-center cohort
items.sourceLevel: Publisher full article and tables read.
items.reason: Historical October29 paper newly indexed.367 patients,147 matched(LE56/ISR91); response selection not included in matching, overlap with prior106-patient cohort, no functional or permanent-stoma outcomes. Table4 labels a simultaneous-covariate model univariable; clarify Cox-model attribution and distinct log-rank/Cox P values before structured effect extraction. Non-significance does not establish equivalence.

items.title: KEYSTEP-008 pembrolizumab/quavonlimab versus pembrolizumab: historical registry results
items.sourceLevel: Complete public registry read; primary results June8,2026, not a November new readout.
items.reason: 302 randomized across treated/untreated cohorts. Prespecified any-AE and AE-discontinuation outcomes NOT_POSTED; SAE table is not equivalent. Last ORR comparison duplicates OG002/OG006 labels with a different estimate. Preserve uncertainty until safety and group mapping resolved.

items.title: Elimusertib plus FOLFIRI phase I: early closure for toxicity
items.sourceLevel: Historical2025 primary full paper and registry results read.
items.reason: 10 mixed-GI participants, only6 CRC; early termination for toxicity, MTD not established. Abstract reports4 DLT versus5 in text/patient table. Registry ORR/CBR nominal denominators differ from6 evaluable patients and some AE risk denominators are inconsistent. Retain negative signal; do not present mixed-cancer PFS as CRC-specific.
